title: 第11章 到哪里都能遇到卷王第12章 新年
slug: 有熟练度面板的我学什么都快
content_zh:
“又要开始三年模拟五年高考的高强度学习了。”
房间里，林潜看到木桌上几本厚厚书籍，长叹了一口气，眼中露出坚定之色。
“先认真看一个月时间，看能不能刷出技能出来。”
林潜已经突破到易筋，倒也不怕修炼进度落后。
据他在演武场听其他师兄聊天中，了解到从练皮突破到炼筋一般要半年多时间，天赋不好的，估计要一年多时间才突破，有的甚至一直卡在练皮。
而林潜只花费了两个多月就突破了，区区一两个月时间，他还是能浪费得起的。
再说他又不是完全不修炼通臂拳。
医书看累了，可以修炼通臂拳，让脑力恢复。
修炼通臂拳累了，体力耗尽了，再看医书，让身体恢复。
主打一个劳逸结合。
“嗯，永动机，我可真机智。”
林潜忍不住笑了。
林潜成为药堂学徒后，他的生活便开始求学之路，生活变得极为规律。
每天早晨先修炼通臂拳，然后再拿出医书认真且仔细的阅读，直到看到眼昏头胀，快打瞌睡时。
林潜就会放弃看书，走出房间修炼通臂拳。
每一次修炼通臂拳，林潜都能感觉体内力量缓缓增长。
修炼完再继续看书，就这样一直持续到晚上。
有时候林潜也会休息半天，什么都不干，到处走走，释放一下身体或者精神上的疲惫。
......
时间匆匆而逝，就这样过了一个月。

林潜现在反而更像书生了，温文尔雅。
金手指果然没让林潜失望，在一周后林潜把医书认真翻完了一遍后，灰色熟练度面板上出现了医师职业。
姓名：林潜
职业：医师（一阶30%）。
寿命：1570。
境界：淬体境--易筋。
武技：通臂拳（三阶15%）。
当林潜看到面板上出现医师职业后，他当时高兴坏了，差点忍不住仰天长啸。
为了庆祝，他在饭堂狠狠的多干了几碗饭。
这一个月修炼通臂拳，林潜发现继续按照传功堂张执事传授的方法修炼通臂拳，通臂拳三阶提升的熟练度很慢，好几天才涨1%。
但是按照林潜通臂拳突破三阶时，脑海中出现的方法修炼通臂拳，两三天就能提升1%，只是修炼一遍时需要花费更多的时间及体力。
虽然如此，通臂拳提升的速度比张管事的快了一倍。
这说明武技突破时，熟练度面板提供的感悟、记忆、方法远远比张执事传授的更加有效。
林潜还发现就算有壮体汤，壮体汤的药效对他好像没有以前管用了。
在药堂打听了下，才知道壮体汤对练皮境界很有效，但是对易筋境界有效，但是效果不大。
content_en:
“It’s time to start another three years of intense study that simulates five years of college entrance examination.”
In the room, Lin Qian saw several thick books on the wooden table and sighed, with a look of determination in his eyes.
"Let's take a careful look at it for a month to see if we can develop skills."
Lin Qian had already broken through to Yi Jin, so he was not afraid of falling behind in his cultivation progress.
According to what he heard from other senior brothers chatting in the martial arts field, he learned that it usually takes more than half a year to break through from skin training to muscle training. For those with poor talent, it is estimated that it will take more than a year to break through, and some even get stuck in skin training.
It only took Lin Qian more than two months to break through. He could still afford to waste just one or two months.
Besides, it’s not like he doesn’t practice Tongjiquan at all.
If you are tired of reading medical books, you can practice Tongjiquan to restore your brain power.
When you feel tired and exhausted from practicing Tongjiquan, read medical books to let your body recover.
Focusing on a work-rest balance.
"Well, perpetual motion machine, I'm so clever."
Lin Qian couldn't help but laugh.
After Lin Qian became an apprentice in the medicine hall, his life began to study and his life became extremely regular.
Practice Tongjiquan every morning, and then take out the medical book and read it carefully until you feel dizzy, dizzy, and about to doze off.
Lin Qian would give up reading and walk out of the room to practice Tongjiquan.
Every time he practiced the through-arm boxing, Lin Qian could feel the strength in his body slowly increasing.
After practicing, continue reading, and continue like this until evening.
Sometimes Lin Qian would rest for half a day, doing nothing but walking around to relieve physical or mental fatigue.
...
Time flies by, and a month has passed like this.
Lin Qian is now more like a scholar, gentle and elegant.
The golden finger did not disappoint Lin Qian. A week later, after Lin Qian carefully read through the medical book, the doctor profession appeared on the gray proficiency panel.
Name: Lin Qian
Occupation: Physician (30% at first level).
Lifespan: 1570.
Realm: Tempering Body Realm - Yijin.
Martial skills: Arm-Through Fist (Level 3: 15%).
When Lin Qian saw the doctor profession appearing on the panel, he was so happy that he almost couldn't help shouting to the sky.
To celebrate, he cooked a few extra bowls of rice in the canteen.
During this month of practicing Tong-Arm Fist, Lin Qian found that if he continued to practice Tong-Arm Fist according to the method taught by Deacon Zhang of the Chuan Gong Hall, his proficiency in the third level of Tong-Arm Fist improved very slowly, and it only took several days to increase by 1%.
However, if you practice Tongjiquan according to the method that appeared in Lin Qian's mind when he broke through to the third level, you can improve it by 1% in two or three days, but it will take more time and physical strength to practice it again.
Even so, the speed of Tongjiquan's improvement was twice as fast as that of Zhang Guanshi.
This shows that when a martial arts breakthrough occurs, the insights, memories, and methods provided by the proficiency panel are far more effective than those taught by Deacon Zhang.
Lin Qian also found that even with the Zhuangti Decoction, the medicinal effect of Zhuangti Decoction did not seem to be as effective for him as before.
After asking around at the medicine hall, I found out that Zhuangshitang Decoction is very effective for the skin training realm, but it is effective for the tendon-changing realm, but the effect is not great.
